arxiv-1603-00974.title: Regression Analysis for Microbiome Compositional Data 1
arxiv-1603-00974.creator: Pixu Shi, Anru Zhang, Hongzhe Li
arxiv-1603-00974.description: Abstract One important problem in microbiome analysis is to identify the bacterial taxa that are associated with a response, where the microbiome data are summarized as the composition of the bacterial taxa at different taxonomic levels. This paper considers regression analysis with such compositional data as covariates.

arxiv-2111-13700.title: Applying the metallicity-dependent binary fraction to double white dwarf formation: Implications for LISA astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Price-Whelan et al. 2018 ) ; COSMIC ( Breivik et al. 2020b ) ; LEGWORK ( Wagg et al. 2021 ) ; matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) ; numpy ( van der Walt et a
arxiv-2111-13700.creator: Sarah Thiele, Katelyn Breivik, Robyn E. Sanderson, Rodrigo Luger
arxiv-2111-13700.description: Abstract Short-period double white dwarf (DWD) binaries will be the most prolific source of gravitational waves (GWs) for the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). DWDs with GW frequencies below ∼ 1 ​ mHz \sim 1\,\rm{mHz} will be the dominant contributor to a stochastic foreground caused by overlapping GW signals.

arxiv-2210-12709.title: Adiabatic-impulse approximation in non-Hermitian Landau-Zener Model
arxiv-2210-12709.creator: Xianqi Tong, Gao Xianlong, Su-peng Kou
arxiv-2210-12709.description: Abstract We investigate the transition from PT-symmetry to PT-symmetry breaking and vice versa in the non-Hermitian Landau-Zener (LZ) models. The energy is generally complex, so the relaxation rate of the system is set by the absolute value of the gap.

arxiv-2211-00350.title: Evaluation of Parameterized Quantum Circuits with Cross-Resonance Pulse-Driven Entanglers Thanks: This work was supported in part by the QISE-NET NSF Fellowship DMR 17-47426
arxiv-2211-00350.creator: Mohannad Ibrahim 1 , Hamed Mohammadbagherpoor 2 , Cynthia Rios 3 , Nicholas T. Bronn 4 and Gregory T. Byrd 5
arxiv-2211-00350.description: Abstract Variational Quantum Algorithms (VQAs) have emerged as a powerful class of algorithms that is highly suitable for noisy quantum devices. Therefore, investigating their design has become key in quantum computing research. Previous works have shown that choosing an effective parameterized quantum circuit (PQC) or ansatz for a VQA is crucial to its overall performance, especially on near-term devices.

arxiv-2304-12628.title: A Moment-SOS Hierarchy for Robust Polynomial Matrix Inequality Optimization with SOS-Convexity Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2304-12628.creator: Feng Guo, Jie Wang
arxiv-2304-12628.description: Abstract We study a class of polynomial optimization problems with a robust polynomial matrix inequality (PMI) constraint where the uncertainty set itself is defined also by a PMI. These can be viewed as matrix generalizations of semi-infinite polynomial programs, since they involve actually infinitely many PMI constraints in general.

arxiv-2304-14194.title: Design of linear block copolymers and A ​ B ​ C ABC star terpolymers that produce two length scales at phase separation
arxiv-2304-14194.creator: Merin Joseph, Daniel J. Read, Alastair M. Rucklidge
arxiv-2304-14194.description: Abstract Quasicrystals (materials with long range order but without the usual spatial periodicity of crystals) were discovered in several soft matter systems in the last twenty years. The stability of quasicrystals has been attributed to the presence of two prominent length scales in a specific ratio, which is 1.93 for the twelve-fold quasicrystals most commonly found in soft matter.

arxiv-2305-05481.title: A proof of a Frankl-Kupavskii conjecture on intersecting families
arxiv-2305-05481.creator: Agnijo Banerjee
arxiv-2305-05481.description: Abstract A family ℱ ⊂ 𝒫 ⁡ ( n ) \mathcal{F}\subset\mathcal{P}(n) is r r -wise k k -intersecting if | A 1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A r | ≥ k |A_{1}\cap\dots\cap A_{r}|\geq k for any A 1 , … , A r ∈ ℱ A_{1},\dots,A_{r}\in\mathcal{F} .

arxiv-2308-01071.title: Automatic Feature Engineering for Time Series Classification: Evaluation and Discussion
arxiv-2308-01071.creator: Aurélien Renault, Vincent Lemaire, Alexis Bondu, Dominique Gay
arxiv-2308-01071.description: Abstract Time Series Classification (TSC) has received much attention in the past two decades and is still a crucial and challenging problem in data science and knowledge engineering. Indeed, along with the increasing availability of time series data, many TSC algorithms have been suggested by the research community in the literature.

arxiv-2405-04593.title: UltraDark.jl: A Julia package for simulation of cosmological scalar fields
arxiv-2405-04593.creator: Nathan Musoke
arxiv-2405-04593.description: Abstract filesRGB.icc † † margin: Preprint: Prepared for submission to Journal of Open Source Software Software • Repository License Authors of papers retain copyright and release the work under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License ( CC BY 4.0 ). Summary UltraDark.jl is a Julia package for the simulation of cosmological scalar fields.

arxiv-2407-05053.title: Adaptive Stiffness: A Biomimetic Robotic System with Tensegrity-Based Compliant Mechanism
arxiv-2407-05053.creator: Po-Yu Hsieh, June-Hao Hou
arxiv-2407-05053.description: Abstract Biomimicry has played a pivotal role in robotics. In contrast to rigid robots, bio-inspired robots exhibit an inherent compliance, facilitating versatile movements and operations in constrained spaces. The robot implementation in fabrication, however, has posed technical challenges and mechanical complexity, thereby underscoring a noticeable gap between research and practice.

arxiv-2411-17455.title: Improved Bethe-Heitler positron creation and retention by combining direct laser acceleration and solid target interaction within a gas jet
arxiv-2411-17455.creator: Lucas Ivan Iñigo Gamiz, Robert Babjak, Bertrand Martinez, Marija Vranić
arxiv-2411-17455.description: Abstract The next generation of Petawatt-class lasers presents the opportunity to study positron production and acceleration experimentally, in an all-optical setting. Several configurations were proposed to produce and accelerate positrons in a single laser stage. However, these configurations have yielded limited positron beam quality and low particle count.

arxiv-2506-00344.title: Efficient Latent Semantic Clustering for Scaling Test-Time Computation of LLMs
arxiv-2506-00344.creator: Sungjae Lee, Hoyoung Kim, Jeongyeon Hwang, Eunhyeok Park, Jungseul Ok
arxiv-2506-00344.description: Abstract Scaling test-time computation—generating and analyzing multiple or sequential outputs for a single input—has become a promising strategy for improving the reliability and quality of large language models (LLMs), as evidenced by advances in uncertainty quantification and multi-step reasoning. A key shared component is semantic clustering, which groups outputs that differ in form but convey the same meaning.

arxiv-2506-20027.title: Dynamic Causal Mediation Analysis for Intensive Longitudinal Data
arxiv-2506-20027.creator: Tianchen Qian
arxiv-2506-20027.description: Abstract Intensive longitudinal data, characterized by frequent measurements across numerous time points, are increasingly common due to advances in wearable devices and mobile health technologies. We consider evaluating causal mediation pathways between time-varying exposures, time-varying mediators, and a final, distal outcome using such data.

arxiv-2507-02949.title: RADIANT : R etrieval A ugmente D ent I ty-context A lig N men T - Introducing RAG-ability and Entity-Context Divergence
arxiv-2507-02949.creator: Vipula Rawte, Rajarshi Roy, Gurpreet Singh, Danush Khanna, Yaswanth Narsupalli, Basab Ghosh, Abhay Gupta, Argha Kamal Samanta, Abhay Gupta, Aditya Shingote, Aadi Krishna Vikram, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha, Amit Sheth, Amitava Das
arxiv-2507-02949.description: Abstract As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to advance, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a vital technique to enhance factual accuracy by integrating external knowledge into the generation process. However, LLMs often fail to faithfully integrate retrieved evidence into their generated responses, leading to factual inconsistencies.

arxiv-2510-03021.title: Differentially Private Wasserstein Barycenters
arxiv-2510-03021.creator: Anming Gu, Sasidhar Kunapuli, Mark Bun, Edward Chien, Kristjan Greenewald
arxiv-2510-03021.description: Abstract The Wasserstein barycenter is defined as the mean of a set of probability measures under the optimal transport metric, and has numerous applications spanning machine learning, statistics, and computer graphics. In practice these input measures are empirical distributions built from sensitive datasets, motivating a differentially private (DP) treatment.

arxiv-2511-17160.title: Cosmological perturbations on an averaged background
arxiv-2511-17160.creator: Pierre Mourier
arxiv-2511-17160.description: Abstract In relativistic cosmology, the formation of nonlinear inhomogeneities can induce non-negligible backreaction on late-time expansion. Among the important consequences for precision cosmology is the potential impact on the linear growth of large-scale structures. We address this impact by combining covariant spatial averaging with covariant and gauge-invariant perturbation theory. We focus on irrotational dust model spacetimes.

arxiv-2512-11033.title: Dynamical disequilibrium in dwarf galaxies: rethinking gas dynamics, rotation curves, and dark matter inference 2025 Dynamical disequilibrium in dwarf galaxies: rethinking gas dynamics, rotation curves, and dark matter inference – B

pmc-10567062.title: Disrupted resting-state functional connectivity and network topology in mild traumatic brain injury: an arterial spin labelling study
pmc-10567062.creator: Fengfang Li, Liyan Lu, Hui Li, Yin Liu, Huiyou Chen, Fang Yuan, Hailong Jiang, Xindao Yin, Yu-Chen Chen
pmc-10567062.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Mild traumatic brain injury can cause different degrees of cognitive impairment and abnormal brain structure and functional connectivity, but there is still a lack of research on the functional connectivity and topological organization of cerebral blood flow fluctuations. This study explored the cerebral blood flow, functional connectivity and topological organization of the cerebral blood flow network in acute mild traumatic brain injury patients.

pmc-11311583.title: Study on the Influences of Inter-Governmental Information Flow and Interdepartmental Collaborative Supervision on Pork Quality: A Case Study in China
pmc-11311583.creator: Linhai Wu, Zhiyu Chen
pmc-11311583.description: To study the influences of the degree of interdepartmental collaborative supervision on the behavioral strategy selection of pig farmers, pig slaughterers, and pork processing manufacturers in the pork supply chain system, this study established a three-party evolutionary game model involving pig farmers, pig slaughterers, and pork processing manufacturers based on the social co-governance framework by focusing on the interdepartmental information

pmc-11619265.title: Pre-vaccination carriage prevalence of Streptococcus pneumoniae serotypes among internally displaced people in Somaliland: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11619265.creator: Kevin van Zandvoort, Abdirahman Ibrahim Hassan, Mohamed Omer Bobe, Casey L Pell, Mohamed Saed Ahmed, Belinda D Ortika, Saed Ibrahim, Mohamed Ismail Abdi, Mustapha A Karim, Rosalind M Eggo, Saleban Yousuf Ali, Jason Hinds, Saeed Mohamood Soleman, Rachael Cummings, Catherine R McGowan, E Kim Mulhollan
pmc-11619265.description: BackgroundPopulations affected by humanitarian crises likely experience high burdens of pneumococcal disease. Streptococcus pneumoniae carriage estimates are essential to understand pneumococcal transmission dynamics and the potential impact of pneumococcal conjugate vaccines (PCV). Over 100 million people are forcibly displaced worldwide, yet here we present only the second pneumococcal carriage estimates for a displaced population.

pmc-11655940.title: Identification of gastric cancer subtypes based on disulfidptosis-related genes: GPC3 as a novel biomarker for prognosis prediction
pmc-11655940.creator: Nan Yi, Xindong Yin, Xiao Feng, Ming Ren, Chaoqun Ma
pmc-11655940.description: Gastric cancer (GC) is the fourth most common cancer type. “Disulfidptosis,” a distinct form of cell death, is initiated through aberrant intracellular disulfide metabolism. Here, we identified various GC subtypes based on disulfidptosis-related genes (DRGs) and constructed a risk score model to identify relevant genes to help predict patient prognosis and guide treatment.

pmc-12522728.title: Preoperative C-reactive protein as a predictor of conversion and complications in laparoscopic cholecystectomy for acute cholecystitis
pmc-12522728.creator: Parham Khoshdani Farahani, Shakiba Khosravi Nejat
pmc-12522728.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionLaparoscopic cholecystectomy (LC) is the gold standard for gallbladder surgery but may require conversion to open surgery in complicated cases. While preoperative C-reactive protein (CRP) is known to reflect inflammation, its predictive role in surgical outcomes remains debated.

pmc-13082908.title: TEVAR-Only Management of Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Rupture Caused by Acute Type B Aortic Dissection after EVAR: A Case Report
pmc-13082908.creator: Toshinori Takahashi, Osamu Namura, Shinya Mimura
pmc-13082908.description: Type B aortic dissection after endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR) is a rare late complication and may cause rupture of a previously stable abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA). A 79-year-old male developed acute Stanford type B aortic dissection 12 years after EVAR, with distal extension into an infrarenal AAA resulting in rupture and circulatory collapse.

pmc-13370290.title: Impact of endovascular revascularization, pharmacotherapy, and supervised exercise therapy on long-term cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, mortality, and limb outcomes in patients with peripheral artery disease: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
pmc-13370290.creator: Jiayue Feng, Shang Ju, Jiawei Zhang
pmc-13370290.description: ObjectiveThis systematic review and network meta-analysis compared the long-term effects of endovascular reconstruction/revascularization (ER), supervised exercise therapy (SET), medical therapy (MT), and their combined regimens on cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events, all-cause mortality, and limb outcomes in patients with peripheral artery disease (PAD).

pmc-13554445.title: Total saponins from Panax ginseng delay aging and cellular senescence via PI3K-AKT pathway in a rapid dual-system screening model of aging
pmc-13554445.creator: Yu-jing Tan, Wen-qi Jin, Jing Wang, Hui Wang, Ting-ting Lou, Li-wei Sun, Fang-bing Liu, Shuai Zhang
pmc-13554445.description: BackgroundAging, as an inevitable biological process, is an inevitable process of multisystem functional decline, with cellular senescence being one of its hallmarks. Although total saponins from Panax ginseng (TSG) offer health benefits, its precise anti-aging mechanisms have not been fully elucidated.

pmc-13609727.title: Cannabigerol at the Interface of the Gut Microbiota and EndoCannabinoidome: Mechanistic Insights into Inflammation and Pain Modulation
pmc-13609727.creator: Gloria Marisol Castañeda-Ruelas, Lucía Elhy Grijalva-Contreras, Geovanna Nallely Quiñonez-Bastidas
pmc-13609727.description: Recent years have seen growing medical interest in the influence of crosstalk between the gut microbiota and the endocannabinoidome (eCBome) on inflammation and pain modulation. Growing evidence indicates that gut microbiota can modify the effects of several marketed drugs, including analgesics.
